interaction_history.overview: A hotshot lawyer gets more than he bargained for when he learns his new boss is Lucifer himself.
interaction_history.title: Devil's Advocate, The

interaction_history.overview: Sheffield, England. Gaz, a jobless steelworker in need of quick cash persuades his mates to bare it all in a one-night-only strip show.
interaction_history.title: Full Monty, The

interaction_history.overview: The same situation is played out in different cities (New York, Berlin and Japan). A lover has to choose whether to commit to a partner who is returning home. In each case there are other people involved, an ex-partner and someone else in a "permanent" relationship, what do they choose to do?
interaction_history.title: Flirt

interaction_history.overview: In a small and conservative Scottish village, a woman's paralytic husband convinces her to have extramarital intercourse so she can tell him about it and give him a reason for living.
interaction_history.title: Breaking the Waves

interaction_history.overview: An FBI undercover agent infilitrates the mob and finds himself identifying more with the mafia life at the expense of his regular one.
interaction_history.title: Donnie Brasco

interaction_history.overview: Matko is a small time hustler, living by the Danube with his 17 year old son Zare. After a failed business deal he owes money to the much more successful gangster Dadan. Dadan has a sister, Afrodita, that he desperately wants to see get married so they strike a deal: Zare is to marry her.
interaction_history.title: Black Cat, White Cat (Crna macka, beli macor)

interaction_history.overview: A middle-aged London factory worker is shocked when the mixed-race daughter she gave up at birth decides to track her down. At first she denies she is her mother. All family members become emotional, as everyone's secrets are exposed.
interaction_history.title: Secrets & Lies

interaction_history.overview: After an abandoned young woman in late 19th Century England is taken in by a rural couple with three handsome sons, tragic consequences result.
interaction_history.title: Feast of July

interaction_history.overview: Lola receives a phone call from her boyfriend Manni. He lost 100,000 DM in a subway train that belongs to a very bad guy. She has 20 minutes to raise this amount and meet Manni. Otherwise, he will rob a store to get the money. Three different alternatives may happen depending on some minor event along Lola's run.
interaction_history.title: Run Lola Run (Lola rennt)

interaction_history.overview: China in the 1920s. After her father's death, 19 year old Songlian is forced to marry the much older lord of a powerful family. With three wives already, each living in a separate house within the great castle, there is fierce competition for his attention and the privileges that are gained. This competition gets out of hand...
interaction_history.title: Raise the Red Lantern
